title: Consume lazily and short-circuit predicates
summary: Distinguish finding one value from testing any or all values. Observe early termination using an inspected-item counter.

borrow.clue: Method creating a shared iterator over values

copy.clue: Adapter using the Copy trait to produce i32 values out of shared references

reduce.clue: Consumer accumulating from an explicit initial zero

observe.clue: Adapter observing each yielded item without changing it

exists.clue: Consumer stopping as soon as the predicate accepts one item

every.clue: Consumer stopping as soon as the predicate rejects one item

first.clue: Consumer returning the first item satisfying the predicate

advance.clue: Iterator method yielding one optional item and advancing the cursor

reference.clue: Operator borrowing the expected first integer for comparison with a shared iterator item

equal.clue: Macro checking how many items remain after advancing once
